quotes.speaker: Tidjane Salaün
quotes.summary_phrase: Tidjane Salaün on team chemistry and his defensive growth
quotes.excerpt: I feel pretty good on my with my body, defensively I feel straight, even better, better and better.
quotes.quote: The team is getting better since the training camp. Good chemistry is coming for this season. I feel like the group is a pretty good group with a lot of character and some good vets that help us to be the best as possible. For my part, I feel pretty good on my with my body, defensively I feel straight, even better, better and better. Then it's just about rhythm. I start to to have a little bit more rhythm. It was my first two preseason game, first time in the arena for a while, and it's cool to be back. We have two more games to prepare to to have a good season with the guys.
quotes.social_post: Tidjane Salaun says the Hornets are building good chemistry and he is feeling better defensively as he finds his rhythm during the preseason

quotes.speaker: Tidjane Salaün
quotes.summary_phrase: Tidjane Salaün on his role and defensive responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: Defense is the main part, that's with my abilities, that's where I can have the most success.
quotes.quote: Completely engage on what they ask me to do about, you know, defense, rebound. Defense is the main part, that's with my abilities, that's where I can have the most success in this team. And then it's just about play with my strengths, about shoot, about passing the ball, make good screen, running, and with all the new abilities I had during the summer, I'm going to have a better, I would say a better, put some pressure on the rim. Just got to find a way just like the practice, to put the pressure on the rim and just dunk on someone. I think I can get at least if I have my rhythm, I can get at least one per game.
quotes.social_post: Tidjane Salaun is focused on his defensive role and rebounding for the Hornets, adding that he wants to put more pressure on the rim and aims to dunk on someone at least once per game

quotes.speaker: Tidjane Salaün
quotes.summary_phrase: Tidjane Salaün on his sister's success in the WNBA
quotes.excerpt: The fact to to see her have success with our team, now to be in final, it's even better.
quotes.quote: Always great to to see my sister play, even more when she's in in America because for for the time it's it's better for me to to watch compared to when it's in Europe. And the fact to to see her have success with our team, now to be in final, it's even better and that inspire me a lot and even more with her her role during this season. She had the six woman of the year. So it's very cool, but it also inspire me of how I can translate what she's doing with our team with me with my team. So it's a it's super cool.
quotes.social_post: Tidjane Salaun says watching his sister succeed in the WNBA and win Sixth Woman of the Year is a major inspiration for his own rookie season with the Hornets

quotes.speaker: Tidjane Salaün
quotes.summary_phrase: Tidjane Salaün's personal goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Take a step, be better defensively, and my team win. All I want is winning.
quotes.quote: Take a step, be better defensively, and my team win. All I want is winning. It's the main goal, you know, and then it's just about find my rhythm and just be as good as I can for my teammates and like I say, yeah, just take a better step offensively.
quotes.social_post: Tidjane Salaun keeps his goals simple for the upcoming season, stating that he wants to take a step forward defensively and help his team win

quotes.speaker: Tidjane Salaün
quotes.summary_phrase: Tidjane Salaün on learning from veteran teammate Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: I know who he is. He's a great player, but he's also angry and he want to prove.
quotes.quote: I had a few talk with Naz and that was just cool to to see him out there during the games, but also when we do some extra work, me and Naz. It's always good to to see someone with this type of character which want more and want to work. It's not every vet, every every guy who come at night, and to see someone like Naz, I know who he is. He's a great player, but he's also angry and he want to prove and to be teammate with him is very cool and I'm trying to to learn from him and all the extra work we we share together. I'm trying to to just take it as a experience for me on my future.
quotes.social_post: Tidjane Salaun is leaning on veteran Naz Reid for guidance, noting that he is trying to learn from the way Reid approaches extra work and his competitive character
